app.title: Showrunner
app.loadError: Could not load data: {{error}}. Is the app running via `npm run dev`?

events.title: Events
events.empty: No events yet. Create the first one — e.g. “New Year’s Eve 2026”.
events.playersHint: The contestants of this event. Each game picks its line-up from this list.
events.gamesHint: The games of this event, in playing order.
events.hideBranding: Hide the “Showrunner” branding in the show

eventGame.title: Configure game
eventGame.instanceNameHint: Leave empty for the game’s default name.
eventGame.selectionHint: Pick from the backlog what gets played at this event — in this order.
eventGame.noItems: This game’s backlog is still empty.

backlog.title: Backlog
backlog.empty: No items in the backlog yet.
backlog.dropHint: Drop files here — one item is created per file

show.lobbyHint: Next (→ / Page ↓ / Space) starts the first game.
show.resumeHint: There is a saved state for this event.
show.gameEndBoardHint: Next goes to the black transition slide.
show.endShowConfirm: Really end the show? The live state will be discarded.
show.resetScoresConfirm: Reset all points to 0? The show keeps running.
show.jumpToGame: Jump to this game (starts at the game intro, scores are kept)

standalone.title: Choose data folder
standalone.explain: Showrunner is running without a local process (standalone). Pick your data folder once — or an empty folder to start fresh. The app reads and writes your events, backlogs and songs right there, as plain files.
standalone.unsupported: This browser does not support standalone mode (File System Access API missing). Please use Chrome or Edge — or run the app via npm run dev.
standalone.denied: No access — selection cancelled or denied. Please try again.

kisum.name: Kisum
kisum.tagline: Music in reverse — who names that tune?
kisum.title: Song title (answer)
kisum.regionHint: Drag to set the active region, click to set the play position. Space plays forward from there — or the last selected region — and stops again.
kisum.settingsItemLabelHint: {{x}} = current number, {{y}} = total. Leave empty to hide the text.

phase.intro: Ready — Next plays the reversed clip
phase.playingEnded: Clip finished — Next = buzz / answer timer
phase.answer: Answer time running! Next = reveal · Back = keep guessing

pixelgesicht.name: Pixelgesicht
pixelgesicht.tagline: A face sharpens pixel by pixel — who names it first?
pixelgesicht.previewHint: Preview uses the default timing. The actual duration is set per event in the game settings.
pixelgesicht.settingsLadderHint: Fine at first (+1 px per stage), then bigger jumps up to half the end resolution, finally via 111 into the end stage (8, 9, 10, 11, 15, 21, 29, 41, 57, 79, 111, 157), then the original. Default: 12 stages of 1.5 s each (18 s reveal).
pixelgesicht.settingsItemLabelHint: {{x}} = current number, {{y}} = total. Leave empty to hide the text.

phase.revealingEnded: Image complete — Next = buzz / answer timer
phase.answer: Answer time running! Next = reveal · Back = keep guessing
